snippet.title: HIKIBYOU2 - Trailer
snippet.description:
Available here: https://blazeepic.itch.io/hikibyou2

HIKIBYOU2 is an action/adventure platfomer with puzzle and stealth elements. Differentiating itself from the first title in the series, Hikikomori No Chuunibyou, is this successor's less realistic approach and more atmospheric vibe. Levels are once again open-ended with the story directing the player.

Features

• Open-ended levels with story-focused progression
• Various platforming challenges and puzzles
• Unlimited continues and frequent checkpoints
• Pixel-art graphics and electronic soundtrack
• Supports Xbox 360 Controller (recommended)
